title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes with Garlic & Herbs
short: Creamy inside, shatteringly crisp outside. The side that steals the show.
keywords: Crispy Smashed Potatoes with Garlic & Herbs, date night, dinner for two, cozy, classic
intro: Boil small potatoes, smash them flat, then roast in a hot oven until the craggy edges turn into crisp shards. A brush of garlic-herb butter at the end makes them taste like a steakhouse side for very little effort.
why: Everybody fights over the crispy edges. They pair with almost every main on this site.

ings.h: 400 g (14 oz)

steps.t: Heat the oven to 230°C (450°F). Boil the potatoes in well-salted water for 15–20 minutes until a knife slides in easily.
Drain and let them steam-dry for 5 minutes.
Oil a sheet pan, add the potatoes and press each with the bottom of a glass to about 1.5 cm (½ in) thick. Drizzle with the rest of the oil and season.
Roast 25–30 minutes until deeply golden and crisp at the edges.
Melt the butter with the garlic and herbs for 1 minute, brush over the potatoes and finish with flaky salt, pepper and parsley.

tips: Steam-drying is what makes them crisp. Wet potatoes steam in the oven.
makeahead: Boil and smash them hours ahead; roast just before dinner.
plating: Pile them in a warm bowl and bring them to the table to share.

faq.a: Cut them into 4 cm chunks before boiling and smash gently.
